structure: Part 7, adding an address in the journey, permanent address and contact address. Read in full: consignment-parties.fit.spec.js (454 lines; its 'add an address from the journey', 'add-address pages for the other roles', 'permanent address' and 'contact address for consignment' describes) and all 6 trace zips the part names, each opened with tim's Playwright 1.65.0 and its full action list taken. Traces, short names used in refs: T1 = consignment-parties--add-an-address-from-the-journey-place-of-origin-an-international-address-entered-by-hand.zip (95 actions); T2 = consignment-parties--add-an-address-from-the-journey-consignee-a-uk-address-found-by-postcode-then-completed.zip (164); T3 = consignment-parties--add-address-pages-for-the-other-roles-consignor-is-entered-by-hand-importer-and-place-of-destination-start-with-a-uk-pos.zip (106); T4 = consignment-parties--permanent-address-cat-one-choice-per-animal-same-as-destination-or-a-new-address.zip (115); T5 = consignment-parties--permanent-address-the-enter-address-path-is-retired-and-lands-on-the-per-animal-page.zip (44); T6 = consignment-parties--contact-address-for-consignment-the-contact-address-page-sends-the-user-to-the-review.zip (45). Every trace first walks the opening run (create-notification, notification type, origin, commodity, reason, consignment details) then navigates to /roles-and-addresses; those pages belong to other parts and are not claimed here. Pages mined, in journey order: (1) /<role>/add-address, the manual add-address form, reached directly from the place of origin and consignor pickers (international roles: 42-country select) and, through 'Enter address manually' or a chosen lookup result, from the consignee, importer and place of destination pickers (UK roles: country fixed to United Kingdom, label 'Postcode'); snapshots T1 actions 55, 66, 84; T2 actions 132, 144, 159; T3 actions 44, 69, 94. (2) /<role>/find-address, the UK postcode step for consignee, importer and place of destination, with its empty and partial-postcode errors; T2 actions 47, 60, 72; T3 actions 56, 81. (3) /<role>/find-address/select, conditional on a postcode being submitted: either 'No addresses found for <postcode>' (T2 action 85) or 'Select an address' with a select of results and its error (T2 actions 101, 113). (4) /permanent-address, which redirects to /permanent-address/select, the per-animal permanent address page shown only for pet consignments (cat): warning, guidance, one card per animal with radios and a conditionally revealed new-address form, its errors, and the POD address shown once one is chosen; T4 actions 50, 63, 83, 100, 104. (5) /permanent-address/enter-address, retired, redirecting to /permanent-address/select (T5 action 39). (6) /contact-address-for-consignment, which redirects to /review-notification (T6 action 40). Network logs of T1, T2, T4, T5, T6 were read for the data calls: every call is a same-origin form POST to the prototype itself, with no outbound address lookup. What the slice does not show (error states on the consignor, importer and place of destination forms, email and phone format checks, the effect of the address-use checkboxes, save-and-return from the permanent address page) is written as gap claims.

claims.statement: The permanent address page is built from its own app-permanent-address-* classes: each animal is a section card, and the caption and heading use custom classes rather than govuk-caption and govuk-heading. It also loads its own script, permanent-address-animals.js. Its standard parts are GOV.UK Frontend radios with conditional reveals, warning text, a bulleted list, inputs and buttons.
claims.ref: trace T4 action 50 (class list under main; .app-permanent-address-animal-card is a SECTION); request 26 (GET /public/javascripts/permanent-address-animals.js)
claims.quote: app-permanent-address-animal-card app-permanent-address-animal-card__heading app-permanent-address-animal-card__legend
claims.note: A GOV.UK summary card or a fieldset per animal with a standard heading could replace the custom card. What the script does is not visible in the trace.

claims.statement: The permanent address new-address fields set their widths with custom classes: three-quarters for name, address lines and email, one-half for town, county and postcode, two-thirds for phone.
claims.quote: app-permanent-address-new-address-fields__input--three-quarters
